nodes.label: Multiplayer ModData Sync Flow
nodes.rationale: Client join flow: Local Initialization creates a server DataController, which loads or creates moddata per player, syncs via GlobalModData, then serves a force-recalced cache to the client — keeps amputation state consistent across host/clients

nodes.label: ProstFamiliarity (Prosthesis Familiarity) Perk
nodes.rationale: Equipping a prosthetic limb gradually awards familiarity XP, making actions with the prosthesis faster over time

nodes.label: Side_L Perk (Left Side Amputation)
nodes.rationale: XP is granted to the amputated side, making timed actions on that side faster at higher skill, offsetting the lost limb

nodes.label: Amputation Mechanic
nodes.rationale: Saw right-click or drag-and-drop cuts off the infected limb; bandages/stitches auto-used to boost survival, tourniquet placed on correct side dampens post-amputation damage; upper arm amputation blocks prosthesis equipping; amputated side gains skill for timed actions

nodes.label: Cicatrization
nodes.rationale: Gradual wound healing after amputation; player must periodically clean wounds with bandages; a prosthesis can be equipped before full cicatrization but risks random bleedings — design intent is to reward post-surgery maintenance

nodes.label: Prosthesis (Hook and Arm)
nodes.rationale: Two prosthesis types exist: Hook (cheaper, actions take longer) and Arm (faster actions at 1.1x speed modifier), trading craft cost for action speed; equipping slowly grants Prosthesis Familiarity
